clue.text: One of a herd for each Latin poet

parts.note: a cow is one animal of a herd of cattle
per is the Latin word for 'for each', as in per annum

explanation.surface: A cowherd's sum per head of livestock, set among Roman verse.
explanation.walkthrough: William Cowper was an English poet of the 18th century, author of 'The Task' and the 'Olney Hymns'.
explanation.definitionFit: William Cowper was an eighteenth-century English writer of verse and hymns.

clue.text: Food that makes footsore little horses

parts.note: a corn is a hard patch of skin that makes the foot sore
a cob is a small sturdy horse

explanation.surface: Some odd fodder that leaves small ponies limping.
explanation.definitionFit: Corncobs are ears of maize, eaten roasted or boiled.

clue.text: Eric as we arranged is a pretentious intellectual

indicators.note: the letters of these three words are arranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Eric's name, rearranged by us, describes a show-off thinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arranged' shuffles ERIC AS WE; 'is' links wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A wiseacre is a person who affects great learning or cleverness, a know-all.

clue.text: Garden hat trend-setter

definitions.meaning: the Garden of ... in Genesis
Anthony ..., British prime minister, made the black homburg fashionable, so it became the 'Anthony ...' hat

explanation.surface: A hat that set a fashion trend at a garden party.
explanation.walkthrough: Anthony Eden was a British prime minister of the 1950s whose favoured homburg hat took his name.
explanation.definitionFit: Paradise in Genesis bears this name, and a stylish politician of that surname popularised a homburg.

clue.text: Colloquially tremendous beating

definitions.meaning: in informal speech 'a ... majority' means a huge one
a thrashing given with the fists

explanation.surface: A slangy way of describing a mighty thrashing.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally the word means very large; literally it is a pounding with blows.

clue.text: Demolition expert whose charge was daylight robbery

definitions.meaning: one who pulls down old buildings, a demolition contractor
in old English law housebreaking was breaking into a dwelling by day, burglary being the night-time offence

explanation.surface: A demolition man whose bills are a rip-off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'daylight robbery' looks like the idiom for an outrageous price, but here it is literal: the old offence of breaking into a house by day.
explanation.definitionFit: Both a contractor who knocks down structures and a thief entering dwellings in daytime carry this title.

clue.text: Fit and proper to encounter

definitions.meaning: an old word for suitable
to come across someone

explanation.surface: Is it right and proper to come across someone?
explanation.definitionFit: The archaic adjective means suitable; the verb means come face to face with.

clue.text: What's-her-name is an O.T. murder victim

parts.note: Abel was killed by his brother Cain in the Old Testament

explanation.surface: Someone half-remembered turns out to be a biblical victim.
explanation.walkthrough: O.T. is the Old Testament; Abel was the first murder victim in Genesis.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's forename serves as an example of a woman whose name one has forgotten.

clue.text: Unwise advice on how to lay out money for the better

definitions.text: Unwise advice on how to lay out money for the better

parts.words: Unwise advice on how to lay out money for the better
parts.note: 'the better' sounds like an improvement, but is the person who bets; the risky advice is to stake money on chance

explanation.surface: A rash tip for investing money for a better return.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'better' as one who bets, not as an improvement.
explanation.definitionFit: To bet or wager is the risky way of spending money a punter is urged towards.

clue.text: Cleopatra's bosom friend in debt gets filed

indicators.note: the serpent is placed inside the word for debt

parts.note: being in the red means owing money, so red stands for debt
Cleopatra killed herself by holding an asp to her breast

explanation.surface: Cleopatra's close companion, deep in debt, gets prosecuted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gets' links wordplay to definition; 'filed' means smoothed with a file or rasp.
explanation.definitionFit: To rasp something is to rub it with a coarse file, so the past tense matches.

clue.text: Tepid description of &an apostle?

parts.note: Luke the evangelist, loosely called an apostle here
the adjective that describes him is warm, an apostle of moderate heat

explanation.surface: A mild account of one of Christ's followers.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags a fanciful reading: a warm Luke.
explanation.definitionFit: Lukewarm water is only moderately warm, neither hot nor cold.

clue.text: The most extensive paradoxically, is a short one that's life!

definitions.text: The most extensive paradoxically, is a short one that's life!

parts.words: The most extensive paradoxically, is a short one that's life!
parts.note: a prison term of life is the lengthiest of terms, yet it is described by one short word

explanation.surface: A philosophical remark that life is brief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'that's life' sounds like a shrug, but it is the judge's sentence of life imprisonment, a lengthy term expressed in one short word.
explanation.definitionFit: A life term is the longest prison punishment a court can impose.

clue.text: To prepare for exam, eat greedily

definitions.meaning: to study intensively just before a test
to stuff food in

explanation.surface: Advice to a student: swot hard for exams and stuff yourself.
explanation.definitionFit: Both last-minute swotting and stuffing food into the mouth mean packing something full.

clue.text: Rustic retreat for one making obeisance

definitions.meaning: a leafy shelter or arbour in a garden
one who bows

explanation.surface: A country hideaway for a courtier who bows low.
explanation.definitionFit: A shady arbour, and also a person who bows in respect.

clue.text: Baker's shovel in the To. M.

definitions.meaning: a flat long-handled shovel used for sliding bread in and out of an oven
the scan's 'To. M' is a misprint of I.O.M., the Isle of Man; this is a town on its west coast

explanation.surface: A bakery tool found on the Isle of Man.
explanation.walkthrough: I.O.M. is the Isle of Man, a self-governing island in the Irish Sea; Peel is a town there.
explanation.definitionFit: A baker's long flat paddle bears this name, as does a west-coast Manx port.

clue.text: Transatlantic fighter got a leg of mutton

parts.note: a GI is an American soldier, from across the Atlantic

explanation.surface: An American soldier got hold of some lamb.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigot is the French-derived name for the hind leg of a sheep as a cut of meat.

clue.text: Roman goddess turned out by the matchmaker

definitions.meaning: the Roman goddess of the hearth
a short match, produced by a match manufacturer

explanation.surface: A goddess dismissed by the marriage broker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'matchmaker' suggests someone arranging marriages, but is a maker of matches; 'turned out' means produced.
explanation.definitionFit: The goddess of hearth fires gave her name to a brand of wax friction matches.

clue.text: Logically, it ought to lead from the Thames to the Isle of Dogs

definitions.text: Logically, it ought to lead from the Thames to the Isle of Dogs

parts.words: Logically, it ought to lead from the Thames to the Isle of Dogs
parts.note: a Thames tributary named for the noise dogs make should by rights flow to the Isle of Dogs

explanation.surface: A geographical note about a waterway near the Isle of Dogs in London.
explanation.walkthrough: Barking Creek is a tributary of the Thames in east London; the Isle of Dogs is a peninsula in the same river, so a creek named for dogs' noise ought to lead there.
explanation.definitionFit: This inlet near Barking in east London joins the Thames, the name suggesting canine noise.

clue.text: Verse about one Italian artist

indicators.note: the word verse goes around the word one

explanation.surface: A poem written about a single painter from Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Paolo Veronese was a sixteenth-century Venetian painter.

clue.text: Procrastinatory confession of the image worshipper

definitions.meaning: someone putting off a task admits '...', run together
one who worships idols

explanation.surface: A delayed admission from someone who reveres statues.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as I DO LATER, what a procrastinator might confess.
explanation.definitionFit: One who reveres graven images, and, split up, a confession of putting things off.

clue.text: Golden Dew Tea-a suitable blend to be seen on the dresser

definitions.text: to be seen on the dresser

indicators.note: the three words are blended together into a new mix, one apt for a suit

explanation.surface: An advertisement for a fitting blend of tea called Golden Dew.
explanation.walkthrough: 'suitable blend' scrambles GOLDEN DEW TEA; 'the dresser' is someone wearing clothes, not a sideboard holding a tea service.
explanation.definitionFit: Donegal tweed is an Irish woollen cloth worn as jackets and suits.

clue.text: Comparatively dull yellow shock absorber

definitions.meaning: buff is a dull yellow, and adding -er makes the comparative
a device that cushions impact, as on railway carriages

explanation.surface: A faded yellow cushioning device.
explanation.definitionFit: A cushioning device on trains, and a mock comparative of the pale yellow colour buff.

clue.text: Barkers markers

definitions.meaning: cairn terriers, a breed of dog
piles of stones set up as landmarks

explanation.surface: Dogs and signposts rhyme.
explanation.definitionFit: Terriers of a Scottish breed share their name with heaps of stones used as landmarks.

clue.text: Raised like the poison tree

parts.note: up means raised
as means like

explanation.surface: Grown in the manner of a toxic tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The upas is a Javanese tree whose sap was used for poisoned arrows.

clue.text: Spanish article about the girl's name

indicators.note: the Spanish article is placed around the word the

parts.note: el is the Spanish for the

explanation.surface: A Spanish article about a woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethel is a female forename.

clue.text: Talkative bird at the voting station

definitions.meaning: The traditional name for a parrot
where votes are cast

explanation.surface: A chatty parrot at the polling place.
explanation.definitionFit: A parrot's stock name, and the casting of votes at an election.

clue.text: Scorch the soldier's tea

definitions.meaning: to burn the surface of
army slang for tea, from Hindi

explanation.surface: A soldier burns his brew.
explanation.definitionFit: To blacken by burning, and the forces' slang word for a cuppa.

clue.text: Retain food for maintenance

definitions.meaning: to hold on to
the food and lodging needed to live

explanation.surface: Hold on to provisions for upkeep.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold on to, and one's board and upkeep, as in 'earn your keep'.

clue.text: Object at a distance; it makes little money

parts.note: far means at a distance
a thing is an object

explanation.surface: Something far off that earns very little.
explanation.walkthrough: A farthing was a pre-1961 British coin worth a quarter of an old penny.
explanation.definitionFit: This tiny former British coin is a byword for a trifling sum.

clue.text: Say it again about vegetable fuel

parts.note: re means about or concerning
peat is decayed plant matter burned as fuel

explanation.surface: Talk about plant-based fuel once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To reiterate is to speak once more.

clue.text: Held back — on account of being reticent?

definitions.meaning: kept back or booked in advance
... also means shy and restrained

explanation.surface: A shy person held back because of reticence.
explanation.definitionFit: Set aside for later use, and quiet and undemonstrative in manner.

clue.text: Show up a soft fruit

parts.note: p is the musical abbreviation for piano, soft
a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Turn up with a mushy fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: To become visible or arrive.
